# Data Research Analysis

> Open-source, AI-powered marketing analytics platform that unifies ad, analytics, and database sources into one revenue-focused model — no SQL or data engineer required.

## Product
- [Data Research Analysis](https://www.dataresearchanalysis.com/): platform overview, capabilities, and pricing
- [Resources](https://www.dataresearchanalysis.com/resources): guides, templates, and downloads

## Problem guides
- [Connect Marketing Spend to Revenue](https://www.dataresearchanalysis.com/connect-marketing-spend-to-revenue): end the MarTech stack mess by unifying spend and revenue data
- [Prove Marketing ROI](https://www.dataresearchanalysis.com/prove-marketing-roi): connect spend to revenue and show exactly how every dollar performs
- [Prove ROI to Your CEO & CFO](https://www.dataresearchanalysis.com/prove-roi-to-ceo): build executive-ready reporting that reconciles with the bank account
- [The Invisible Drain](https://www.dataresearchanalysis.com/invisible-drain): stop losing hours to manual data work and spreadsheet upkeep
- [The Exhaustion Wall](https://www.dataresearchanalysis.com/exhaustion-wall): reduce marketing burnout caused by data drudgery
- [Strategic Velocity](https://www.dataresearchanalysis.com/strategic-velocity): real-time marketing analytics without report lag
- [The Technical Translation Trap](https://www.dataresearchanalysis.com/technical-translation-trap): stop being IT support for dashboards with no-code analytics

## Articles
- [Articles library](https://www.dataresearchanalysis.com/articles): in-depth articles on marketing analytics, attribution, GA4, and ROI
